grade.went_well: The answer names the declaring module and both realizations correctly. It quotes the presolve computation exactly with the right line, and lists the core init/reset sites and the reading modules accurately. It also keeps declaration, computation and reading visibly separate.
grade.answer_key_issues: The key's reader list (core, 21_tax, 33_carbonRemoval, 47_regipol) leaves out 46_carbonpriceRegi/netZero, which reads pm_taxCO2eqSum at postsolve.gms:68 to rescale the regional markup. The key also doesn't mention that 47_regipol/regiCarbonPrice writes it (presolve.gms:24, postsolve.gms:962-1001), or the conditional overwrite in core/postsolve.gms:49-57.
grade.summary: The declaration (46_carbonpriceRegi), the computation (core/presolve.gms:10) and the reader list are correct and well cited. The main error is the claim that 21_tax/on and 46_carbonpriceRegi/netZero overwrite pm_taxCO2eqSum. Both only read it; 47_regipol is the only module that writes it. The 2030 clamp and the core/postsolve overrides are also presented without their switch conditions (cm_CO2PriceLimit, cm_emiscen).
